description: This file defines a SwiftUI view named GatewayDiscoveryDebugLogView, responsible for displaying and copying discovery debug logs within the Gateway section of the app. It includes UI elements like a list of log entries, a button to copy logs, and utility functions for date formatting.

methods.name: formattedLog
methods.description: Generates a formatted string of all discovery debug log entries for copying.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a HH:mm:ss string.

methods.name: formatISO
methods.description: Formats a Date object into an ISO8601 string with fractional seconds.
